description: This file contains the implementation of an Orleans v3-compatible hasher class named Orleans3CompatibleHasher, which implements the IHasher interface. It provides hash functions for non-string grain key IDs, utilizing the JenkinsHash method for computation.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleHasher
classes.description: A hasher implementation compatible with Orleans v3, used for non-string grain key IDs, relying on JenkinsHash for hash computations.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Property providing a description of the hasher, indicating it uses Orleans v3 hash function with JenkinsHash.

methods.name: Hash (byte[] data)
methods.description: Method that computes hash for a byte array by converting it to a ReadOnlySpan and delegating to the other Hash method.

methods.name: Hash (ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
methods.description: Method that computes the hash of a ReadOnlySpan<byte> using JenkinsHash.ComputeHash, cast to int, with unchecked context to handle overflow.
